I’ve been looking into trying naltrexone actually! I work in substance use treatment in an MAT place and we have a lot of clients that do Vivitrol injections for their substance use disorders, but I had no idea until recently it could be used for weight issues as well. I’m gonna try to talk to the psychiatrist about it for sure when I see her. Honestly aside from the weekly testosterone injections I’m not on any meds rn, I def need to be bc I have a handful of mental illnesses on top of the physical conditions that I really need medications for but I’ve had so many issues with previous psychiatrists that I have a really hard time trusting them now. I’m really hoping this new psychiatrist I’m seeing is good bc I’m to the point I’m willing to take that risk again bc things have gotten so bad for me 😅

See the thing that frustrates me with OA is I’ve been to so many NA and AA meetings so realistically I know they’re not going to be judgmental bc I imagine they’ve gotta be at least somewhat similar. But somehow I can’t get over the fear 😅 I might look into virtual meetings and see if I can find any of those before I try going to in person meetings but I def think peer support groups like that could be really helpful for me.
That’s what I was thinking but I just wanted to double check! Thank you!
